title.zh: ⚡️贝莱德六年来首次转向超配短期美债，并下调美股评级
title.en: ⚡️贝莱德六年来首次转向超配短期美债，并下调美股评级

current_state.zh: BlackRock's investment institute raised short-term US Treasuries to overweight and cut US equities from overweight to neutral for the first time in roughly six years, citing attractive yields above 5.2% and potential volatility from the AI capital-expenditure buildout.
current_state.en: BlackRock's investment institute raised short-term US Treasuries to overweight and cut US equities from overweight to neutral for the first time in roughly six years, citing attractive yields above 5.2% and potential volatility from the AI capital-expenditure buildout.
